description: the man of the reference picture riding: a huge very muscular warlord, tanned skin crossed by thin glowing cracks of yellow-white magma, long wild dark brown hair and a thick braided dark brown beard with iron rings, eyes blazing yellow-white, a crown of jagged black obsidian horns with small flames burning between them, black volcanic rock pauldrons with molten gold edges, a bare muscular chest, a wide golden belt, a skirt of black and molten gold plates, a long mantle of black smoke and glowing orange embers hanging behind from the shoulders, its edge clean and outlined, black armoured boots with gold trim, no axe and nothing in the hands but the reins; sitting tall and upright astride a saddle that is not drawn, the back straight, not squatting and not crouching, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing right, the head, chest and hips turned fully to the right; both forearms reaching forward, the two hands together in front of the body holding short reins that end just in front of the hands; only the near leg showing and only one foot in the whole picture: the thigh lying forward and level from the hip to the knee, the knee bent at a right angle, the lower leg hanging vertically straight down from the knee, one whole foot at the bottom with the toes pointing right; the cloak and any long hair hanging down behind the back, not spread out; the far leg completely hidden and not drawn at all, no second boot and no second foot; the whole figure from the tips of the crown's horns and flames to the sole of the foot inside the picture with room around it; nothing under the rider; isolated figure on a plain background

references.usage: the character's look: this same man, his face, hair, beard, crown of horns and fire, armour, smoke mantle and colours, drawn the same way; not his standing pose and not the war axe
